summary: Verified all social/external link fixes for Toyer Hair site. Navbar top bar (IG/FB), Footer (IG/FB/TikTok), Contact page (IG/FB/TikTok/WhatsApp/Maps), Floating Action Buttons (fab-whatsapp, fab-directions, fab-call), and the Google Reviews CTA on both / and /reviews were audited for href correctness, target=_blank and rel='noopener noreferrer'. Also validated that clicking a real footer link spawns a new browser tab (context.pages increased) instead of SPA-navigating. 68/68 attribute-level assertions PASS. New-tab spawn behavior also confirmed. No issues found.

verification_details.new_tab_click_test: Clicked footer Instagram anchor -> context.expect_page fired, new page URL = https://www.instagram.com/accounts/login/?next=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Ftoyerr_hair&is_from_rle (Instagram redirected to login for unauthenticated visitor - destination confirmed via 'next' param). New tab opened successfully; SPA did not navigate away.

critical_code_review_comments: All external anchor tags are consistently using target='_blank' with rel='noopener noreferrer' - good security practice.
BUSINESS constants in /app/frontend/src/lib/business.js are the single source of truth used by Navbar, Footer, Contact, FloatingActions and GoogleReviews - DRY compliant.
GoogleReviews.jsx correctly falls back to BUSINESS.googleReviews when the /api/google-reviews response is not from Google source, so the CTA always points to a valid URL.

Minor observation (non-blocking): Instagram will show a login gate to unauthenticated visitors regardless - not a link bug, but end users may be surprised. Consider linking to the mobile share URL or ensuring the profile is public if not already.
context_for_next_testing_agent: External link correctness verified. If future changes touch /app/frontend/src/lib/business.js or any of Navbar/Footer/Contact/FloatingActions/GoogleReviews, re-run the anchor-attribute audit (href + target + rel) across / , /reviews and /contact pages.
rca of the issue: N/A - fixes verified working. Previously reported broken Google reviews URL (containing 'si=' or '#lrd=0x0:0x0') is no longer present anywhere. Facebook URL correctly points to /Toyerhair. All social/external links open in new tab with proper noopener+noreferrer.
